category_title: Quiet students with ambiguous comprehension during independent work
scenario_title: Distraction and disengagement during self-paced online learning
minimal_context: The student is working independently on a computer-based assignment using the Novanet online instructional program.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please log into the Novanet online instructional program and continue your self-paced lesson on the computer.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares blankly at the monitor) This program is boring.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should do next on the screen?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know. I do not seem to learn from the online lessons.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep trying to read through the material.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts their head on the desk, gets distracted, and begins to text on their cell phone instead of looking at the assignment.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please log into the Novanet online instructional program and continue your self-paced lesson on the computer.

STUDENT: (Stares blankly at the monitor) This program is boring.

STUDENT: I don't know. I do not seem to learn from the online lessons.

TUTOR: Just keep trying to read through the material.

STUDENT: (Puts their head on the desk, gets distracted, and begins to text on their cell phone instead of looking at the assignment.)

task.content: Working independently on computer-based assignments, projects, or music assignments using the Novanet online instructional program

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Using the Novanet online instructional program for self-paced learning
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Got distracted and got on some other websites or text on cell phones, or just had their heads on the desk
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Expressed discontent with the Novanet online instructional program. Students strongly feel that the program is boring and they do not seem to learn from the online lessons

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Got distracted and got on some other websites or text on cell phones, or just had their heads on the desk
